dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Oh, you bet I do. A whole list!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: But, I didn't want to step on your toes, seeing as this is your place and all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wh—What were you considering?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Um, that maybe... we could... build a campsite?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds nice.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: R—Really? Awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Let me see... First, we'll need at least two tents.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: First one's for resting. We'll put thick cloth up around the walls to keep any noise out.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: We could even use that one for research or to organize our documents.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: The other tent will be a space to chat and play games. We can put picnic supplies and chairs near the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: The weather here seems pretty nice, so we shouldn't need any rain or wind protection...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Then, I guess the only thing left would be adding some adventure to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: No matter how beautiful the scenery, standing back and looking at it's gonna get old sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: You've got to get out there and enjoy it!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: And if there were mechanisms that we could use to jump, run, climb, or glide around this place, that would be the cherry on top!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Install stuff like that, and whoosh! Nothing here would be off-limits.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I could ask Tubby about that.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Ah, you mean that little finch with the nice smile?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Perfect! I've actually talked to her already. All that stuff she knows about housekeeping... Super impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I couldn't get her to tell me about all of her contraptions, but I understand. Every organization has its secrets... The Temple of Silence is like that too.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'll find a way.

choices.text: Turning this into an amusement park, are we?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Perfect! Glad to have your stamp of approval!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Well, I'll get designing, then. I'll let you know when the blueprints are ready.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You can invite your other friends over once it's done. The more, the merrier!

choices.text: Whatever makes you happy. I've got more than enough space.
